policy: Lead visual review of all 36 sectors and the eight candidate sheets. Native closeups resolve partial glyphs. Coordinates are approximate printed-symbol centers. A sector overview is not proof that no faint symbol can remain. Do not turn terrain or lettering into settlements.

sectorReview.method: Visual overview at quarter native resolution; contact-sheet review and native closeups for new glyphs and ambiguous components.
sectorReview.unresolved: Further faint/dark symbols may still be found. This is an audited expansion, not an independently certified complete census.

coordinateCorrections.reason: Detector caught the lower-left component; center of the same castle is northeast, confirmed in v4-dorne-norte.png.
